normalization: DOM div.css-hafgtc p.txt; remove U200B-D/2060/2063/FEFF and trim; exclude title p0/empty p; double LF join; hashes UTF8 and positions/lengths UTF16 zero-based; prefix exactly first1000 joined-body units
boundary_span_method: Intl.Segmenter(ko,sentence) on each nonempty body DOM p separately; trim each segment and retain nonempty UTF16 lengths. UI, silence and nonverbal fragments stay included and separately labelled. This is a boundary-proxy distribution, not linguistic sentence or utterance counts. Quantile uses sorted[floor((N-1)*q)].
semantic_rubric: Local functional groups only. First-p information units include current questions/intentions as tasks, not verified future facts, and exclude explicit prior-chapter recap. Action groups merge repeated same-goal speech and adjacent action/cause; intentions and past events are not current execution. Human referent groups can overlap and include recalled/collective/off-scene referents; no distinct-person count. Setting groups are explanatory clusters, not atomic propositions. All coding is nonexhaustive and not independent verification.
surface_position_scope: Predeclared selected literal surface strings only; substring indexOf, no word-boundary or coreference resolution. Null prefix match is not whole-work absence. No complete named-entity inventory claimed.
